summary: Celldex Therapeutics filed a routine Form 8-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing a press release under Item 8.01 reporting positive topline Phase 3 results from the EMBARQ-CSU1 and EMBARQ-CSU2 trials of barzolvolimab in chronic spontaneous urticaria. Both studies met the primary endpoint of mean change in weekly UAS7 at Week 12 and all key secondary endpoints across two dose groups, including in omalizumab-refractory patients, with efficacy sustained to Week 24 and a favorable safety profile. Treatment continues to 52 weeks, with a BLA submission anticipated in 2027. No special-situation transaction terms apply.
